prompt: Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Set headings in Cooper Hewitt and reading text in EB Garamond; institutional sans heading with literary body. Use Paper and Carmine: page #FFFFFF, text #202020, accent #AF173B, secondary surface #F0F2F2, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 20px, heading 80px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
